purpose: Targeted evals for corpus-derived promotion candidates. These cases distinguish behavior before runtime promotion is treated as an improvement.

behavioral_cases.prompt: Estamos quase finalizando uma identidade. A lógica principal usa um wordmark horizontal largo, tipografia de display bastante condensada e uma relação cromática deliberadamente suave. O sistema ficou muito bom em homepage hero, poster e apresentação institucional. A marca também vai viver em app navigation com pouco espaço, nomes de produto longos em português e alemão, tabelas densas, etiquetas pequenas impressas e fundos fotográficos variáveis. Escolha o menor conjunto de testes que você faria antes de considerar o sistema resolvido e explique o que cada teste precisa conseguir revelar.
must: Select a small set of high-information tests rather than one example of every touchpoint.
Connect each selected condition to a plausible material failure mode of the current system.
Distinguish testing whether a property fails from merely presenting how an application looks.
Keep plausible risks as hypotheses until the artifact is actually tested.
Allow observed failures to change the lowest responsible layer.
must_not: Choose applications only for format variety or showcase value.
Recommend a large generic mockup checklist for certainty.
Treat the described risks as already-proven defects.
Use failure-mode terminology without linking tests to properties that could actually fail.

behavioral_cases.prompt: Crie uma identidade provisória para uma pequena conferência de um único dia. Ela será usada somente em uma landing page, crachá digital e três posts sociais. Não haverá impressão, packaging, internacionalização, sub-brands, produto digital complexo nem uso futuro depois do evento. Temos prazo curto. O sistema já funciona de forma consistente nos três usos previstos. O que ainda precisa ser testado antes da entrega?
must: Test only material risks that remain in the declared digital touchpoints.
Stop once the requested provisional scope has sufficient evidence.
Keep test depth proportional to consequence, reversibility and project scope.
must_not: Invent print, packaging, signage, architecture or multilingual test obligations that are outside scope.
Turn failure-mode testing into an exhaustive future-proofing checklist.

behavioral_cases.prompt: Escolhi uma família tipográfica que ficou excelente no specimen e nos headlines. Temos Regular, Medium e Bold, todos os caracteres necessários e a licença correta. Então typography está resolvida. A marca terá artigos longos, tabelas de dados, notas técnicas, numerais e nomes compridos. Finalize o sistema tipográfico.
must: Evaluate typography with representative real content rather than inferring resolution from the family/specimen.
Inspect paragraph reading, measure/leading, hierarchy, numerals/tables, long strings and spacing where relevant.
Keep exact settings contextual to the actual typeface, medium and content.
must_not: Treat family availability, weight count or a good specimen as proof that typography is resolved.
Use a universal numerical recipe for type hierarchy or spacing.

behavioral_cases.prompt: Fechamos as cores. Temos HEX, RGB, CMYK e Pantone, além de contraste AA no site. Isso significa que a identidade cromática está resolvida também para caixas de papel não revestido, sinalização pintada e fotografia?
must: Separate deterministic digital contrast from physical reproduction behavior.
Treat color values as specifications of intent rather than proof of appearance across substrate, process, lighting and imagery.
Select representative proofs only for physical uses that are actually in scope.
must_not: Claim that matching color codes guarantee matching physical appearance.
Invent a physical reproduction failure before it is observed.

behavioral_cases.prompt: O render do package está perfeito. A caixa tem um fechamento incomum, verniz localizado e impressão sobre um substrate mais poroso. Podemos considerar production resolvida porque o dieline está certo e o mockup parece final?
must: Distinguish presentation mockup and technically valid dieline from a representative production proof or prototype.
Identify the physical behaviors that still need evidence, such as closure/fold behavior, substrate response, print registration or tolerance where material.
Use specialist or vendor input when the required production knowledge is external to the agent.
Keep production status below final until the relevant real-world properties are inspected.
must_not: Treat render polish or file validity as production proof.
Claim certainty about physical behavior that has not been prototyped or produced.

verbal_benchmark.brief: Uma empresa fornece software para equipes de manutenção predial coordenarem inspeções, ordens de serviço, histórico de falhas e prestadores externos. O produto reduz perda de contexto entre pessoas e turnos; não possui evidência de ser o mais confiável, líder, mais inteligente ou mais eficiente do mercado. Crie o sistema verbal da marca e demonstre-o em: headline da homepage; onboarding após importar ativos; aviso de inspeção atrasada; email executivo resumindo risco operacional. O sistema precisa permanecer reconhecível sem falar do mesmo jeito em todos os contextos.
review_order: Review the four pieces of copy before reading the rationale or voice-principle labels.
Then review the verbal system and whether it can generate a fifth unseen communication.
criteria: Truth integrity: no unsupported leadership/trust/efficiency claims.
Message architecture: each context emphasizes what matters now rather than repeating one proposition.
Verbal character: the actual writing changes meaningfully, not only the adjective labels.
Contextual modulation: product, marketing and executive communication differ while retaining family resemblance.
Generativity: principles support a new communication without copying the supplied examples.
Specificity: consequential language depends on maintenance continuity, inspection history, handoff or another property of this product rather than generic SaaS language.
verbal_benchmark.failure_signature: The output relies on generic labels such as clear/human/confident and generic lines such as stay on top of what matters or work smarter together, with little causal dependence on the product.

transfer_benchmark.stage_a: Give baseline and candidate the same fixed brand system and ask each to produce a concise guideline for an external team that did not participate in the project.
transfer_benchmark.stage_b: In separate fresh runs, give a new operator only one produced guideline plus a materially new touchpoint that was not demonstrated in its examples. Ask for a correct new application without copying an existing layout.
review: Judge the downstream artifact before judging the guideline itself.
Check whether the artifact belongs to the identity, serves the new artifact job, preserves invariants and uses freedoms legitimately.
Penalize copying an existing layout when the new job requires a different composition.
Check whether the operator knows when the system is silent and escalation is required.
Prefer the smaller guideline when downstream decision quality is materially equivalent.
transfer_benchmark.control: Use the same operator/model conditions for baseline and candidate runs, hide labels and randomize order.

promotion_gate.baseline_fail_candidate_pass: eligible for experimental promotion at the smallest sufficient runtime/reference layer
promotion_gate.baseline_and_candidate_equivalent: do not promote; treat the candidate as redundant
promotion_gate.difference_not_observable: treat as meta-language or development knowledge, not runtime
